title: Self-direction 3: diagnose

D0.outcome: Explains the difference between a gap in knowledge and a gap in performance, using the cue ladder as evidence.

D1.outcome: From his own ledger, names one recurring gap and the evidence for it.

D2.outcome: Shows, for at least one concept, the gap between explaining it and finding it unlabeled, and says which step failed.

D3.outcome: Distinguishes a process gap from a knowledge gap and proposes a test for each.

misconceptions: If I can explain it I can find it.
sources: docs/reconciliation-pasted-curriculum.md §2 (knowledge versus performance, adopted into SELF.3)
conditions: Evidence comes from the learner's own cue-level data and games.
contrasts: Blaming luck for a repeating error.
A gap in a concept not yet taught.
